title:
Base type for custom schema upgrade during provisioning. To add an upgrade step, add a function
to a type that mixes in this type with the name somethingMeaningful_n , where "n" is the next available schema version
(they start at 1 and the next available schema version is 1 higher than the highest "n" in any already existing
function).  For example:

```
type MySchemaUpgrade mixes SchemaUpgrade {
  upgradeFixedAsset_1 : function()
  upgradeServicePoint_2 : function()

  // Next available is _3
}
```

Mark all internal functions used by upgrade functions as private; that will ensure that they will be ignored
when determining the validity of the upgrade function definitions.

All upgrade functions MUST BE IDEMPOTENT!  In other words, they must work properly if they are applied multiple
times and if earlier attempts failed due to non-logic errors (e.g. server crashes).

Upgrade functions will be automatically applied, as required, at the end of the deployment process for an app.
This means that the upgrade logic in each upgrade function needs to take into account what the automatic schema
upgrade process would have done as far as column/table creation or table renaming.

Also, the following rules will be enforced on types that mixin this type.  They are:

1. Only functions of the form somethingMeaningful_n will be allowed.

2. No gaps in schema versions will be allowed.

3. No further mixing of or in any type that mixes in this type will be allowed.

@see SchemaMigrationVersion for checking the current state debugging
